sentences.zh: 況今禹迹齊軌，九隩同文，司勳抗策，普天增佇。

translations.literal: Now the traces of Yu are aligned on the same track and the nine borderlands share one script; the Director of Merit raises his plan and all under heaven adds its gaze.
translations.idiomatic: Now the realm is one script; merit is proclaimed; all heaven watches.

sentences.zh: 遂公高挹，大愆國章，三靈眷屬，朕實祗懼。

translations.literal: Yet Gaozu holds himself high and the great fault against state statutes is grave; the three spirits attend—We are truly in reverent fear.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Gaozu still declines; the state's rites wait; the spirits watch—I am in awe.

sentences.zh: 便宜顯答羣望，允崇盛典。

translations.literal: It is fitting to answer clearly the hopes of the masses and to grant the lofty ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: It is time to answer the people's hope and grant the great ceremony.

sentences.zh: 其進位相國，總百揆，揚州牧，封十郡為宋公，備九錫之禮，加璽綬、遠遊冠，位在諸侯王上，加相國綠綟綬。

translations.literal: Let him advance to Prime Minister, oversee the hundred officials, remain Governor of Yangzhou, enfeoff ten commanderies as Duke of Song, complete the rites of the nine bestowals, add seals and cords and the far-wandering cap, rank above the princes and kings, and add the Prime Minister's green cord and seal.
translations.idiomatic: Let him become Prime Minister, oversee all offices, remain Yangzhou's governor, take ten commanderies as Duke of Song with the nine honors, seals and the far-wandering cap, rank above princes, with the prime minister's green seal.

sentences.zh: 策曰：

translations.literal: The investiture document said:
translations.idiomatic: The investiture said:

sentences.zh: 朕以寡昧，仰贊洪基，夷羿乘釁，蕩覆王室，越在南鄙，遷于九江。

translations.literal: We, being few and dim, uphold the great foundation; Yi of the east seized the opportunity and overturned the royal house; We were driven to the southern marches and moved to Jiujiang.
translations.idiomatic: We are dim yet uphold the foundation; Yi seized his chance and overthrew the throne; we fled south to Jiujiang.

sentences.zh: 宗祀絕饗，人神無位，提挈羣凶，寄命江滸。

translations.literal: The ancestral sacrifices were cut off and men and spirits had no place; We were dragged by a pack of villains and entrusted Our life to the river's edge.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifice ceased; spirits had no place; we were dragged by villains to the river's edge.

sentences.zh: 則我祖宗之業，奄墜于地，七百之祚，翦焉既傾，若涉淵海，罔知攸濟。

translations.literal: Then the work of Our ancestors fell to the ground; the seven hundred years of fortune was already toppled; as if crossing a deep sea, We knew no ford.
translations.idiomatic: Our ancestors' work fell; seven hundred years of fortune collapsed; we were in a deep sea with no ford.

sentences.zh: 天未絕晉，誕育英輔，振厥弛維，再造區宇，興亡繼絕，俾昏作明。

translations.literal: Heaven did not end Jin and bore an heroic assistant; he shook the slackened cords and remade the realm, continuing the fallen and restoring the cut off, making the dim bright.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven did not end Jin and bore a hero; he remade the realm, continued the fallen, made dark bright.

sentences.zh: 元勳至德，朕實賴焉。

translations.literal: In primordial merit and utmost virtue We truly rely on him.
translations.idiomatic: In utmost merit We truly rely on him.

sentences.zh: 今將授公典策，其敬聽朕命：

translations.literal: Now We shall confer the canon and command upon him; let him respectfully hear Our command:
translations.idiomatic: Now We confer the canon; let him hear Our command:

sentences.zh: 乃者桓玄肆僭，滔天泯夏，拔本塞源，顛倒六位，庶僚俛眉，四方莫卹。

translations.literal: In former days Huan Xuan ran riot in usurpation, flooding heaven and extinguishing Xia, uprooting the root and blocking the source, overturning the six positions; the multitude of officials bowed their brows and the four quarters had no comforter.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Xuan usurped, flooded heaven, uprooted order, overturned the six positions; officials bowed and the realm had no comforter.

sentences.zh: 公精貫朝日，氣凌霄漢，奮其靈武，大殲羣慝，剋復皇邑，奉帝歆神。

translations.literal: Gaozu's essence pierced the morning sun, his spirit crossed the Milky Way; he roused his divine martial and greatly destroyed the pack of villains, recovered the imperial city, and presented the emperor to the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu's spirit pierced the sun; his martial might destroyed the villains, recovered the capital, and restored the throne to the spirits.

sentences.zh: 此公之大節，[7]始於勤王者也。

translations.literal: This was Gaozu's great principle, [7] beginning in the service of the righteous king.
translations.idiomatic: This was his great principle, [7] beginning when he served the righteous cause.

sentences.zh: 授律羣后，泝流長騖，薄伐崢嶸，獻捷南郢，大憝折首，羣逆畢夷，三光旋采，舊物反正。

translations.literal: He received the law among the lords, rode the current in long gallop, made light campaign against the lofty peaks, presented victory at Southern Ye, broke the great villain's head, and utterly leveled the pack of rebels; the three luminaries turned their light and the old things returned to right.
translations.idiomatic: He took command among lords, swept south, broke the great villain's head, leveled rebels; the three lights returned and order was restored.

sentences.zh: 此又公之功也。

translations.literal: This too was Gaozu's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: This too was his achievement.

sentences.zh: 出藩入輔，弘茲保弼，阜財利用，繁殖生民，編戶歲滋，疆宇日啟，導德明刑，四境有截。

translations.literal: Going out to the frontier and entering as assistant, he enlarged this protection and support, enriched goods and benefited use, multiplied the living people, household registers increased year by year, the frontier daily opened, he guided virtue and clarified punishment, and the four borders had bounds.
translations.idiomatic: He served within and without, enriched the people, opened the frontier, guided virtue and law, and bounded the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 此又公之功也。

translations.literal: This too was Gaozu's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: This too was his achievement.

sentences.zh: 鮮卑負眾，僭盜三齊，狼噬冀、青，虔劉沂、岱，介恃遐阻，仍為邊毒。

translations.literal: The Xianbei bore their multitudes and usurped and stole the three Qi; like wolves they devoured Ji and Qing and reverently slaughtered Yi and Dai; relying on distant barriers they still became border poison.
translations.idiomatic: The Xianbei usurped the three Qi, devoured Ji and Qing, slaughtered Yi and Dai, and poisoned the border.

sentences.zh: 公蒐乘秣駟，敻入遠疆，衝櫓四臨，萬雉俱潰，竊號之虜，顯戮司寇，拓土三千，申威龍漠。

translations.literal: Gaozu gathered chariots and fed steeds and entered the far frontier; assault towers looked down on four sides and ten thousand parapets all collapsed; the usurping captives were displayed and punished by the Minister of Crime, and three thousand li of territory were opened, extending authority to the dragon desert.
translations.idiomatic: He fed steeds and entered the far frontier; towers assaulted and ramparts fell; usurpers were displayed; three thousand li opened to the desert.

sentences.zh: 此又公之功也。

translations.literal: This too was Gaozu's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: This too was his achievement.

sentences.zh: 盧循妖凶，伺隙五嶺，乘虛肆逆，侵覆江、豫，旍拂寰內，矢及王城，朝野喪沮，莫有固志，家獻徙卜之計，國議遷都之規。

translations.literal: Lu Xun, demonic and vicious, watched for a gap in the five ridges; riding the void he ran riot and overran Jiang and Yu; his banners brushed within the seas and his arrows reached the royal city; court and countryside lost heart and none had firm will; families offered plans to move their tombs and the state discussed shifting the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xun watched the five ridges, seized his chance, overran Jiang and Yu, reached the capital; court and country despaired; some urged moving the capital.

sentences.zh: 公乘轅南濟，義形于色，嶷然內湛，視嶮若夷，攄略運奇，英謨不世，狡寇窮衂，喪旗宵遁，俾我畿甸，拯於將墜。

translations.literal: Gaozu drove his shafts south across the river; righteousness showed in his face; inwardly he was calm and deep; he looked on peril as level; he spread strategy and moved with wonder; his heroic plan was unmatched in the age; the cunning bandit was driven to extremity and lost his banners fleeing by night; he saved Our capital district from the verge of falling.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu crossed south; righteousness showed on his face; he met peril as level; the bandit fled by night; he saved the capital from falling.

sentences.zh: 此又公之功也。

translations.literal: This too was Gaozu's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: This too was his achievement.

sentences.zh: 追奔逐北，揚旍江濆，偏旅浮海，指日遄至。

translations.literal: Pursuing the fleeing and driving the north, he raised banners on the river's bank; a detached brigade floated on the sea and arrived within days.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued north and raised banners on the river; a fleet came by sea within days.

sentences.zh: 番禺之功，俘級萬數，左里之捷，魚潰鳥散。

translations.literal: At Panyu the achievement: captives and heads by the tens of thousands; at Zuoli the victory: fish scattered and birds broken.
translations.idiomatic: At Panyu tens of thousands were taken; at Zuoli the foe scattered like fish and birds.

sentences.zh: 元凶遠迸，傳首萬里，海南肅清，荒服來款。

translations.literal: The chief villain fled far; his head was transmitted ten thousand li; south of the sea was pacified and the wild domains came to offer allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: The chief villain fled; his head traveled ten thousand li; the south was pacified and barbarians submitted.

sentences.zh: 此又公之功也。

translations.literal: This too was Gaozu's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: This too was his achievement.

sentences.zh: 劉毅叛換，負釁西夏，凌上罔主，志肆姦暴，附麗協黨，扇蕩王畿。

translations.literal: Liu Yi rebelled and changed allegiance, bearing guilt in western Xia, insulting the ruler above and indulging treacherous violence, clinging to factions and stirring the royal precinct.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yi rebelled in the west, insulted the throne, clung to factions, and stirred the capital.

sentences.zh: 公御軌以刑，消之不日，倉兕電泝，神兵風掃，罪人斯得，荊、衡清晏。

translations.literal: Gaozu held the track and punished; within days they were dissolved; the prison oxen flashed like lightning and divine troops swept like wind; the guilty man was obtained and Jing and Heng were cleared and tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu punished with law; within days the rebels fell; Jing and Heng were cleared.

sentences.zh: 此又公之功也。

translations.literal: This too was Gaozu's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: This too was his achievement.

sentences.zh: 譙縱怙亂，寇竊一隅，王化阻閡，三巴淪溺。

translations.literal: Qiao Zong relied on disorder and bandits stole a corner; royal transformation was blocked and the three Ba were drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Qiao Zong relied on chaos; bandits held a corner; the three Ba were drowned.

sentences.zh: 公指命偏師，授以良圖，凌波浮湍，致屆井絡，僭豎伏鑕，梁、岷草偃。

translations.literal: Gaozu directed a detached army and entrusted it with a good plan; crossing waves and floating rapids, they reached Jingluo; the usurping chieftain was put in the cangue and Liang and Min bowed like grass.
translations.idiomatic: He sent a detached force with a good plan; they crossed the waters to Jingluo; the usurper was bound and Liang and Min bowed.

sentences.zh: 此又公之功也。

translations.literal: This too was Gaozu's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: This too was his achievement.

sentences.zh: 馬休、魯宗，阻兵內侮，驅率二方，連旗稱亂。

translations.literal: Ma Xiu and Lu Zong blocked arms and made internal strife, driving and leading the two regions, linking banners and calling it rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xiu and Lu Zong raised arms within, drove two regions, and called it rebellion.

sentences.zh: 公投袂星言，研其上略，江津之師，勢踰風電，迴斾沔川，實繁震懾，二叛奔迸，荊、雍來蘇，玄澤浸育，溫風潛被。

translations.literal: Gaozu flung his sleeves and spoke like a star, studying the upper strategy; at the Yangzi ford the army's momentum exceeded wind and lightning; turning the banners on the Mian River truly multiplied shock and fear; the two rebels ran and Jing and Yong were renewed; dark grace soaked and nurturing, warm wind secretly spread.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu marched like lightning to the Yangzi ford; the rebels fled; Jing and Yong revived under his grace.

sentences.zh: 此又公之功也。

translations.literal: This too was Gaozu's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: This too was his achievement.

sentences.zh: 永嘉不競，四夷擅華，五都幅裂，山陵幽辱，祖宗懷沒世之憤，遺氓有匪風之思。

translations.literal: In Yongjia the contest failed and the four barbarians seized splendor; the five capitals split apart and mountain tombs suffered hidden shame; the ancestors harbored the fury of perishing unavenged and the remnant people bore the thought of a wicked wind.
translations.idiomatic: After Yongjia the barbarians seized power; the five capitals split; ancestors burned with unavenged rage and the people with shame.

sentences.zh: 公遠齊伊宰納隍之仁，近同小白滅亡之恥，鞠旅陳師，赫然大號，分命羣帥，北徇司、兗。

translations.literal: Gaozu far matched the benevolence of the Yi regent who took the drowning in his arms and near shared the shame of Duke Huan of Qi in extinguishing the fallen; he arrayed troops and proclaimed the host, grandly raising the great call, dividing command among the lords and marching north along Si and Yan.
translations.idiomatic: He matched ancient benevolence and Qi Huan's shame; he arrayed troops, proclaimed the host, and sent lords north to Si and Yan.

sentences.zh: 許、鄭風靡，鞏、洛載清，偽牧逆藩，交臂請罪，百年榛穢，一朝掃滌。

translations.literal: Xu and Zheng bent to the wind; Gong and Luo were cleared in the record; false governors and rebellious frontiers crossed arms and begged guilt; a hundred years of thorns and filth were swept away in one morning.
translations.idiomatic: Xu and Zheng submitted; Gong and Luo were cleared; false lords begged guilt; a hundred years' filth was swept in one morning.

sentences.zh: [8]此又公之功也。

translations.literal: [8] This too was Gaozu's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: [8] This too was his achievement.

sentences.zh: 公有康宇內之勳，重之以明德。

translations.literal: Gaozu has the achievement of bringing peace within the seas, and it is redoubled by bright virtue.
translations.idiomatic: He has peace within the seas, redoubled by bright virtue.

sentences.zh: 爰初發迹，則奇謨冠古，電擊強妖，則鋒無前對，聿寧東畿，大造黔首。

translations.literal: When he first raised his traces, his wondrous plans crowned the ancients; when he struck with lightning at strong demons, his edge had no peer; he then pacified the eastern capital and greatly made the black-headed people.
translations.idiomatic: From the first his plans crowned the ancients; his edge had no peer; he pacified the east and saved the people.

sentences.zh: 若乃草昧經綸，化融於歲計，扶危靜亂，道固於苞桑。

translations.literal: As for ordering the realm in its dawn and transforming it in yearly reckoning, supporting the endangered and quieting disorder, his way was firm in the mulberry bud.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the dawn realm, quieted disorder, and made his way firm as the mulberry bud.

sentences.zh: 辯方正位，納之軌度，蠲削煩苛，較若畫一，淳風美化，盈塞宇宙。

translations.literal: He distinguished square from position and received it into measure; he cut away troublesome harshness so that it compared as if drawn with one stroke; pure wind and beautifying teaching filled and blocked the cosmos.
translations.idiomatic: He set square and position, cut harsh law to one stroke, and filled the cosmos with pure teaching.

sentences.zh: 是以絕域獻琛，遐夷納貢，王略所宣，九服率從。

translations.literal: Therefore the farthest domains offered jade and distant barbarians brought tribute; where the royal plan was proclaimed, the nine services followed in obedience.
translations.idiomatic: So the farthest domains offered tribute; where his plan reached, the nine regions obeyed.

sentences.zh: 雖文命之東漸西被，咎繇之邁于種德，何以尚茲。

translations.literal: Though when Wen Ming's influence spread east and west, and Gao Yao's virtue surpassed planting grain, how could they be set above this?
translations.idiomatic: Even Wen Ming's reach east and west, Gao Yao's virtue in planting—none could stand above this.

sentences.zh: 朕聞先王之宰世也，庸勳尊賢，建侯胙土，褒以寵章，崇其徽物，所以協輔皇家，永隆藩屏。

translations.literal: We have heard that when the former kings governed the world they used merit to honor the worthy, established marquis and enfeoffed with soil, rewarded with favoring seals and elevated with emblematic objects—thus to assist and support the royal house and forever strengthen the frontier screen.
translations.idiomatic: The ancient kings honored merit, enfeoffed lords, and gave emblems—to support the throne and strengthen the realm.

sentences.zh: 故曲阜光啟，遂荒徐宅，營丘表海，四履有聞。

translations.literal: Therefore Qufu was brightly opened and Xu lands were extended; Yingqiu faced the sea and his four treads were heard.
translations.idiomatic: Qufu opened and Xu spread; Yingqiu faced the sea and his fame rang fourfold.

sentences.zh: 其在襄王，亦賴匡霸，又命晉文，備物光錫。

translations.literal: In the time of King Xiang of Zhou they likewise relied on lords who aided hegemony, and again they commanded Duke Wen of Jin, completing the objects and bright bestowals.
translations.idiomatic: Under King Xiang of Zhou lords aided hegemony; Duke Wen of Jin received the full bright honors.

sentences.zh: 惟公道冠前烈，勳高振古，而殊典未加，朕甚懵焉。

translations.literal: Only Gaozu's way crowns the heroes of old and his achievement towers and shakes antiquity, yet the special canon has not been added—We are very dull indeed.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu's way crowns the past and his merit towers over antiquity, yet the special honors are not complete—We are dull indeed.

sentences.zh: 今進授相國，以徐州之彭城沛蘭陵下邳淮陽山陽廣陵、兗州之高平魯泰山十郡，封公為宋公。

translations.literal: Now advance and confer Prime Minister, with Pengcheng, Pei, Lanling, Xiapi, Huaiyang, Shanyang, Guangling of Xu province and Gaoping, Lu, Taishan of Yan province—ten commanderies—and enfeoff him as Duke of Song.
translations.idiomatic: Now confer Prime Minister and ten commanderies—Pengcheng, Pei, Lanling, and the rest—and enfeoff him as Duke of Song.

sentences.zh: 錫茲玄土，苴以白茅，爰定爾居，用建冢社。

translations.literal: Bestow this dark earth and wrap it with white thatch; settle your dwelling and thereby establish the altar of soil.
translations.idiomatic: Bestow the dark earth wrapped in white thatch; fix your dwelling and raise the altar of soil.

sentences.zh: 昔晉、鄭啟藩，入作卿士，周、邵保傅，出總二南，內外之重，公實兼之。

translations.literal: Formerly Jin and Zheng opened their frontiers and entered as ministers; Zhou and Shao guarded and tutored and went out to oversee the two souths—inner and outer weight, Gaozu truly holds both.
translations.idiomatic: Jin and Zheng entered as ministers; Zhou and Shao tutored abroad—Gaozu holds both inner and outer weight.

sentences.zh: 今命使持節、兼太尉、尚書左僕射、晉寧縣五等男湛授相國印綬，[9]宋公璽紱；

translations.literal: Now command the Bearer of the Staff, Concurrent Grand Commandant, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Fifth-Rank Baron of Jinning Zhan to confer the Prime Minister's seal and cord, [9] and the Duke of Song's seal and tassel;
translations.idiomatic: Now Bearer of the Staff Zhan, Concurrent Grand Commandant and Left Vice Director, Baron of Jinning, shall confer the Prime Minister's seal [9] and the Duke of Song's seal;

sentences.zh: 使持節、兼司空、散騎常侍、尚書、陽遂鄉侯泰授宋公茅土，金虎符第一至第五左，[10]竹使符第一至第十左。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff, Concurrent Minister of Works, Palace Attendant, Master of Writing, Marquis of Yangsui Tai to confer the Duke of Song's soil, the golden tiger tally first through fifth on the left, [10] and the bamboo tally first through tenth on the left.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer Tai shall confer the Duke of Song's soil, golden tiger tallies one through five left [10], and bamboo tallies one through ten left.

sentences.zh: 相國位無不總，禮絕朝班，居常之名，宜與事革。

translations.literal: The Prime Minister's position brooks no exclusion; his rites cut off the court ranks—the name used in ordinary times should change with the affair.
translations.idiomatic: The Prime Minister brooks no exclusion; his rites cut off the court—ordinary titles should change with the office.

sentences.zh: 其以相國總百揆，[11]去「錄尚書」之號。

translations.literal: Let him as Prime Minister oversee the hundred officials, [11] and remove the title "Recorder of the Masters of Writing."
translations.idiomatic: Let him as Prime Minister oversee all offices [11] and drop the title Recorder of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 上送所假節、侍中貂蟬、中外都督太傅太尉印綬，[12]豫章公印策。

translations.literal: Send up the borrowed staff, Palace Attendant's cicada-fur, seals of Concurrent Supervisor Within and Without, Grand Tutor, and Grand Commandant, [12] and the seals and investiture of Duke of Yuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: Send up the borrowed staff, attendant's cicada-fur, seals of supervisor, grand tutor, and grand commandant [12], and the Yuzhang duke's seal.

sentences.zh: 進揚州牧，領征西將軍、司豫北徐雍四州刺史如故。

translations.literal: Advance him as Governor of Yangzhou, retaining General Who Campaigns West and Inspector of Si, Yu, Northern Xu, and Yong as before.
translations.idiomatic: Advance him as Yangzhou's governor, retaining Campaign West and Si, Yu, Northern Xu, and Yong.

sentences.zh: 公紀綱禮度，萬國是式，乘介蹈方，罔有遷志。

translations.literal: Gaozu's nets and rites are the pattern of ten thousand states; riding the inner and treading the square, he has no shifting intent.
translations.idiomatic: His rites are the pattern of all states; he rides the inner and treads the square without shifting.

sentences.zh: 是以錫公大輅、戎輅各一，玄牡二駟。

translations.literal: Therefore bestow upon him a great carriage and a war carriage, each one, and dark stallions two teams of four.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore bestow a great carriage and a war carriage, and two teams of dark stallions.

sentences.zh: 公抑末敦本，務農重積，采蘩實殷，稼穡惟阜。

translations.literal: Gaozu restrains the tip and honors the root, devotes himself to agriculture and treasures accumulation; picking duckweed is truly abundant and grain fields are lofty.
translations.idiomatic: He restrains luxury and honors the root, devotes himself to farming; the fields grow rich.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公袞冕之服，赤舄副焉。

translations.literal: Thereupon bestow upon him the robes of the dragon and the red shoes to match.
translations.idiomatic: Bestow the dragon robes and red shoes.

sentences.zh: 公閑邪納正，移風改俗，陶鈞品物，如樂之和。

translations.literal: Gaozu corrects the crooked and receives the straight, shifts the wind and changes custom, molds all things like the harmony of music.
translations.idiomatic: He corrects the crooked, shifts custom, molds all things like music's harmony.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公軒縣之樂，六佾之舞。

translations.literal: Thereupon bestow upon him the suspended music of the hall and the dance of six rows.
translations.idiomatic: Bestow hall music and the six-row dance.

sentences.zh: 公宣美王化，導揚休風，華夷企踵，遠人胥萃。

translations.literal: Gaozu proclaims beautiful royal transformation, conducts and raises good wind; Hua and Yi stand on tiptoe and distant men all gather.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaims royal transformation; Chinese and barbarians gather; distant men come.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公朱戶以居。

translations.literal: Thereupon bestow upon him the vermilion door to dwell in.
translations.idiomatic: Bestow the vermilion gate to dwell in.

sentences.zh: 公官方任能，網羅幽滯，九臯辭野，髦士盈朝。

translations.literal: Gaozu in office employs the able, nets the remote and stagnant; from the nine marshes they leave the wild and talented gentlemen fill the court.
translations.idiomatic: He employs the able and nets the neglected; talent fills the court.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公納陛以登。

translations.literal: Thereupon bestow upon him the inner steps to ascend.
translations.idiomatic: Bestow the inner steps to ascend.

sentences.zh: 公當軸處中，率下以義，式遏寇讎，清除苛慝。

translations.literal: Gaozu at the axle stands in the center and leads those below by righteousness, checks bandit enemies and clears away harsh abuses.
translations.idiomatic: He stands at the center, leads by righteousness, checks enemies and clears abuses.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公虎賁之士三百人。

translations.literal: Thereupon bestow upon him three hundred tiger guards.
translations.idiomatic: Bestow three hundred tiger guards.

sentences.zh: 公明罰恤刑，庶獄詳允，放命干紀，罔有攸縱。

translations.literal: Gaozu clarifies punishment and pities executions; all prisons are examined and approved; those who defy command and violate discipline have nowhere to escape.
translations.idiomatic: He clarifies punishment and pities the condemned; rebels have nowhere to flee.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公鈇、鉞各一。

translations.literal: Thereupon bestow upon him an axe and a yue, each one.
translations.idiomatic: Bestow an axe and a yue.

sentences.zh: 公龍驤鳳矯，咫尺八紘，括囊四海，折衝無外。

translations.literal: Gaozu soars like dragon and phoenix; within a foot the eight directions; he bundles the four seas and breaks the foe without.
translations.idiomatic: He soars like dragon and phoenix, holds the eight directions, bundles the four seas, breaks foes abroad.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公彤弓一，彤矢百，盧弓十，盧矢千。

translations.literal: Thereupon bestow upon him one red bow, one hundred red arrows, ten black bows, and one thousand black arrows.
translations.idiomatic: Bestow one red bow, a hundred red arrows, ten black bows, a thousand black arrows.

sentences.zh: 公溫恭孝思，致虔禋祀，忠肅之志，儀刑萬方。

translations.literal: Gaozu is warm, respectful, filial, and thoughtful; he reaches sincerity in suburban sacrifice; his loyal and solemn will is the model for ten thousand regions.
translations.idiomatic: He is warm, filial, sincere in sacrifice; his loyal will models all regions.

sentences.zh: 是用錫公秬鬯一卣，圭瓚副焉。

translations.literal: Thereupon bestow upon him one jar of black millet ale and a libation cup and ladle to match.
translations.idiomatic: Bestow black millet ale, a libation cup and ladle.

sentences.zh: 宋國置丞相以下，一遵舊儀。

translations.literal: In the state of Song set Chancellor and below, all following the old statutes.
translations.idiomatic: In Song set Chancellor and below by old statute.

sentences.zh: 欽哉！

translations.literal: Reverently!
translations.idiomatic: Reverently!

sentences.zh: 其祗服往命，茂對天休，簡恤庶邦，敬敷顯德，以終我高祖之嘉命。

translations.literal: Respectfully receive the coming command, richly answer heaven's favor, simply comfort the many states, respectfully spread bright virtue, to complete Our High Ancestor's excellent command.
translations.idiomatic: Receive the command, answer heaven, comfort the states, spread bright virtue, and complete the High Ancestor's charge.

sentences.zh: 置宋國侍中、黃門侍郎、尚書左丞、郎，隨大使奉迎。

translations.literal: Set in the state of Song Palace Attendant, Gentleman of the Yellow Gate, Left Assistant of the Masters of Writing, and Gentlemen, to follow the great envoy in welcome.
translations.idiomatic: Set Song's attendants and gentlemen to follow the envoy in welcome.

translations.literal: An editorial annotation marker in the received text.
translations.idiomatic: An editorial annotation marker in the received text.

sentences.zh: 枹罕虜乞佛熾槃遣使詣公求効力討羌，拜平西將軍、河南公。

translations.literal: The captive of Baohan, Qifu Chiban, sent envoys to Gaozu offering strength to campaign against the Qiang; he was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Duke of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Qifu Chiban of Baohan sent envoys offering help against the Qiang; he was made Pacifier of the West and Duke of Henan.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月，公以舟師進討，留彭城公義隆鎮彭城。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirteenth year Gaozu advanced by water army in punitive campaign and left Duke of Pengcheng Yilong to guard Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the thirteenth year Gaozu marched by water and left Yilong of Pengcheng to guard the city.

sentences.zh: 軍次留城，經張良廟，令曰：「夫盛德不泯，義在祀典，微管之歎，撫事彌深。

translations.literal: The army halted at Liucheng, passed the temple of Zhang Liang, and ordered: "When great virtue is not extinguished, righteousness lies in the sacrificial canon; the sigh over the slight service of Guan Zhong grows deeper as one handles the affair.
translations.idiomatic: At Liucheng he passed Zhang Liang's temple and ordered: "Great virtue is not lost; sacrifice is right. The sigh for Guan Zhong grows deeper as one acts.

sentences.zh: 張子房道亞黃中，照隣殆庶，風雲玄感，[14]蔚為帝師，大拯橫流，夷項定漢，固以參軌伊、望，冠德如仁。

translations.literal: Zhang Zifang's way was next to the yellow center and his illumination nearly matched the multitude; wind and cloud responded in mystery, [14] he flourished as the emperor's teacher, greatly rescued the crosscurrent, leveled Xiang and settled Han—thus he may be ranked with Yi and Wang, his crown virtue like benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: Zifang's way neared the center; wind and cloud answered [14]; he became the emperor's teacher, saved the flood, ended Xiang and settled Han—ranked with Yi and Wang.

sentences.zh: 若乃神交圯上，道契商洛，顯晦之間，窈然難究，源流淵浩，莫測其端矣。

translations.literal: As for divine communion on the dike, his way matched Shang and Luo; between hidden and manifest it was remote and hard to exhaust; the source stream was deep and vast and its end could not be measured.
translations.idiomatic: His communion on the dike matched Shang and Luo; hidden and manifest were hard to fathom; his source was deep beyond measure.

sentences.zh: 塗次舊沛，佇駕留城，靈廟荒殘，遺象陳昧，撫迹懷人，慨然永歎。

translations.literal: Passing old Pei on the road, halting the chariot at Liucheng, the spirit temple was desolate and ruined and the transmitted image dim; touching the traces and cherishing the man, he sighed endlessly.
translations.idiomatic: Passing old Pei he halted at Liucheng; the temple was ruined and the image dim; he sighed for the man.

sentences.zh: 過大梁者或佇想於夷門，遊九原者亦流連於隨會。

translations.literal: Those who passed Daliang sometimes stood long in thought at Yimen; those who traveled Jiuyuan also lingered at Suihui.
translations.idiomatic: Travelers at Daliang thought of Yimen; travelers at Jiuyuan lingered at Suihui.

sentences.zh: 可改構榱桷，修飾丹青，蘋蘩行潦，以時致薦。

translations.literal: Let the rafters be rebuilt, the red and green repaired; duckweed and traveling water offered in season.
translations.idiomatic: Rebuild the rafters, repair the colors, offer seasonal sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 以紓懷古之情，用存不刊之烈。

translations.literal: Thus to ease the feeling for antiquity and preserve undying splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ease love of antiquity and preserve undying fame.

sentences.zh: 」天子追贈公祖為太常，父為左光祿大夫，讓不受。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven posthumously enfeoffed Gaozu's grandfather as Grand Minister of Ceremonies and his father as Left Household Counsellor; he declined and did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor enfeoffed his grandfather and father posthumously; he declined.

sentences.zh: 二月，冠軍將軍檀道濟等次潼關。

translations.literal: In the second month Champion General Tan Daoji and others halted at Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Tan Daoji and others reached Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰，大軍入河。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen in the third month the great army entered the river.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen in the third month the great army entered the river.

sentences.zh: 索虜步騎十萬，營據河津。

translations.literal: The barbarians of the north, infantry and cavalry a hundred thousand, camped and held the river ford.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred thousand northern barbarians held the river ford.

sentences.zh: 公命諸軍濟河擊破之。

translations.literal: Gaozu ordered the armies to cross the river and struck, breaking them.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu ordered a crossing and broke them.

sentences.zh: 公至洛陽。

translations.literal: Gaozu reached Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu reached Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 七月，至陝城。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he reached Shancheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he reached Shancheng.

sentences.zh: 龍驤將軍王鎮惡伐木為舟，自河浮渭。

translations.literal: Dragon Cavalry General Wang Zhen'e made boats of wood and floated from the river into the Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhen'e built wooden boats and floated from the river into the Wei.

sentences.zh: 八月，扶風太守沈田子大破姚泓於藍田。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Administrator of Fufeng Shen Tianzi greatly defeated Yao Hong at Lantian.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Shen Tianzi of Fufeng greatly defeated Yao Hong at Lantian.

sentences.zh: 王鎮惡剋長安，生擒泓。

translations.literal: Wang Zhen'e took Chang'an and captured Hong alive.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhen'e took Chang'an and captured Hong alive.

sentences.zh: 九月，公至長安。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Gaozu reached Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Gaozu reached Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 長安豐全，帑藏盈積。

translations.literal: Chang'an was abundant and complete; the treasury stores were full.
translations.idiomatic: Chang'an was abundant; treasuries were full.

sentences.zh: 公先收其彝器、渾儀、土圭之屬，獻于京師；

translations.literal: Gaozu first collected its ritual vessels, armillary sphere, earth square, and the like, and presented them to the capital;
translations.idiomatic: He first sent ritual vessels, the armillary sphere, and the earth square to the capital;

sentences.zh: 其餘珍寶珠玉，以班賜將帥。

translations.literal: the rest of the precious treasures and jade he distributed to the generals and commanders.
translations.idiomatic: the rest he gave to his generals.

sentences.zh: 執送姚泓，斬于建康市。

translations.literal: He escorted and sent Yao Hong, who was beheaded in the market of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Yao Hong to be beheaded in Jiankang's market.

sentences.zh: 謁漢高帝陵，大會文武於未央殿。

translations.literal: He visited the tomb of Emperor Gao of Han and held a great assembly of civil and military men in Weiyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He visited Gaozu of Han's tomb and feasted civil and military men in Weiyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 十月，天子詔曰：

translations.literal: In the tenth month the Son of Heaven's edict said:
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the emperor's edict said:

sentences.zh: 朕聞先王之莅天下也，上則大寶以尊德，下則建侯以褒功。

translations.literal: We have heard that when the former kings faced the world above they honored the great treasure by virtue and below established marquis to reward achievement.
translations.idiomatic: The ancient kings above honored virtue and below enfeoffed merit.

sentences.zh: 是以成勳告就，文命有玄圭之錫，四海來王，姬旦饗龜、蒙之封。

translations.literal: Thus when accomplished merit was reported complete, Wen Ming had the black jade bestowed; when the four seas came as kings, the Duke of Zhou enjoyed the tortoise and banner of Meng.
translations.idiomatic: When merit was complete Wen Ming received black jade; when the seas came as kings the Duke of Zhou received tortoise and banner.

sentences.zh: 夫翼聖宣績，輔德弘猷，禮窮元賞，寵章希世。

translations.literal: Wing the sage and proclaim achievement, assist virtue and enlarge plan—the rites exhaust the highest reward and favoring seals are rare in the age.
translations.idiomatic: To wing the sage and assist virtue exhausts the highest rites; such favor is rare.

sentences.zh: 況明保沖昧，獨運陶鈞者哉！

translations.literal: How much more for one who brightly protects the young and dim and alone turns the potter's wheel!
translations.idiomatic: How much more one who protects the young throne and turns the wheel alone!

sentences.zh: 朕以不德，遭家多難，雲雷作屯，夷羿竊命，失位京邑，遂播蠻荊，艱難卑約，制命凶醜。

translations.literal: We, lacking virtue, encountered many difficulties in the house; cloud and thunder made hardship; Yi of the east stole the mandate; We lost place in the capital and were driven to the southern wilds; hardship was base and contracted, and command was held by vicious villains.
translations.idiomatic: We lack virtue; the house met hardship; Yi stole the mandate; we fled south; villains held command.

sentences.zh: 相國宋公，天縱睿聖，命世應期，誠貫三靈，大節宏發。

translations.literal: Prime Minister of Song Gaozu was heaven-conferred wise and sage, fate-filled for the age; sincerity pierced the three spirits and the great principle broadly arose.
translations.idiomatic: Prime Minister Gaozu of Song is heaven-wise, fate-filled; his sincerity pierced the three spirits.

sentences.zh: 拯朕躬於巢幕，迴靈命於已崩，固已道窮北面，暉格八表者矣。

translations.literal: He rescued Our person from the nest's curtain and turned the spirit's mandate from already collapsed—thus his way has exhausted facing north and his brilliance grids the eight regions.
translations.idiomatic: He rescued us from the nest and restored the collapsed mandate; his way grids the eight regions.

sentences.zh: 及外積全國之勳，內累戡黎之伐，芟夷強妖之始，蘊崇姦猾之源，顯仁藏用之道，六府孔修之績，莫不雲行雨施，能事必舉，諒已方軌於三、五，不容於典策者焉。

translations.literal: Moreover outward he piled achievement of preserving the whole state and inward he accumulated merit of pacifying the black-headed people; at the beginning of cutting down the strong demons he amassed the sources of heaping up the treacherous and crafty; the way of showing benevolence and hiding use, the achievement of the six treasuries greatly repaired—none failed to move like cloud and rain; able affairs were surely raised; truly he has squared the track of the Three and Five and cannot be contained in the canon.
translations.idiomatic: Outward he saved the state, inward he pacified the people; he cut demons and repaired the six treasuries; his deeds square the Three and Five.

sentences.zh: 自永嘉喪師，綿踰十紀，五都分崩，然正朔時暨；

translations.literal: Since Yongjia lost the army, more than ten eras passed; the five capitals split apart, yet the correct calendar still reached them;
translations.idiomatic: Since Yongjia more than ten eras passed; the five capitals split, yet the calendar still reached them;

sentences.zh: 唯三秦懸隔，未之暫賓。

translations.literal: only the three Qin hung apart and for a time were not guests.
translations.idiomatic: only the three Qin hung apart and were not yet guests.

sentences.zh: 至令羌虜襲亂，淫虐三世，資百二之易守，恃函谷之可關，廟算韜略，不謀之日久矣。

translations.literal: Until now the Qiang bandits have carried on disorder, licentious and cruel for three generations, relying on the ease of holding the hundred-two, trusting that Hangu Pass could be closed—temple calculation and strategy have not been plotted for many days.
translations.idiomatic: The Qiang ravaged three generations, trusting Hangu Pass—long unplotted.

sentences.zh: 公命世撫運，闡曜威靈，內研諸侯之慮，外致上天之罰。

translations.literal: Gaozu commands the age and nurtures the turn, displays bright martial spirit; inward he studies the lords' concerns, outward he brings heaven's punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu commands the age, displays martial spirit, studies lords within and brings heaven's punishment without.

sentences.zh: 故能倉兕甫訓，則許、鄭風偃，鉦鉞未指，則瀍、洛霧披。

translations.literal: Therefore when the prison oxen were first trained, Xu and Zheng bent to the wind; before battle-axes pointed, Yong and Luo parted the mist.
translations.idiomatic: When armies trained, Xu and Zheng bent; before axes pointed, Yong and Luo cleared.

sentences.zh: 俾舊闕之陽，復集萬國之軫，東京父老，重覩司隸之章。

translations.literal: He made the yang of the old gap gather again the axle-ends of ten thousand states; the elders of the eastern capital again saw the seal of the Director of the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: The old capital's light gathered the realm; eastern elders saw the Director's seal again.

sentences.zh: 俾朕負扆高拱，而保大洪烈。

translations.literal: He made Us bear the throne high and folded, and preserve the great blazing merit.
translations.idiomatic: He let us hold the throne high and preserve great merit.

sentences.zh: 是用遠鑒前典，延即羣謀，敬授殊錫，光啟疆宇。

translations.literal: Therefore We distantly mirror the former canon, extended to the counsel of the masses, respectfully conferred the special bestowal, and brightly opened the frontier realm.
translations.idiomatic: We mirrored the canon, took counsel, conferred special honors, and opened the frontier.

sentences.zh: 乘馬之制，有陋舊章；

translations.literal: The system of chariots of four horses had the old statutes made shabby;
translations.idiomatic: The chariot system was shabby by old statute;

sentences.zh: 徽稱之美，未窮上爵。

translations.literal: the beauty of emblematic titles did not exhaust the highest rank.
translations.idiomatic: emblematic titles did not reach the highest rank.

sentences.zh: 豈足以顯報懋功，允塞民望；

translations.literal: How could they clearly repay majestic achievement and fill the people's hope;
translations.idiomatic: How could they repay majestic merit and fill the people's hope;

sentences.zh: 藩輔王畿，長轡六合者乎。

translations.literal: screen and assist the royal precinct, long rein the six harmonies?
translations.idiomatic: screen the capital and rein the six harmonies?

sentences.zh: 實以公每秉謙德，卑不可踰，難進之道，以寵為戚。

translations.literal: Truly because Gaozu each time holds modest virtue and low cannot be surpassed, the hard-to-advance way takes favor as grief.
translations.idiomatic: Truly Gaozu is modest beyond reach; he takes favor as grief.

sentences.zh: 是故降損盛制，且有後命也。

translations.literal: Therefore We lowered and diminished the grand system and there was a later command.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore we lowered the grand system and left a later command.

sentences.zh: 自茲迄今，洪勳彌劭，稜威九河，魏、趙底服，迴轅崤、潼，連城冰泮。

translations.literal: From then until now the blazing achievement is still more strong; awl authority on the nine rivers, Wei and Zhao bottom-submitted; turning the shafts on Xiao and Tong, linked cities melted like ice.
translations.idiomatic: Since then merit grew; the nine rivers submitted; linked cities melted at Xiao and Tong.

sentences.zh: 遂長驅灞、滻，懸旍龍門，逆虜姚泓，係頸就擒。

translations.literal: Then he drove long on Ba and Chan, hung banners at Dragon Gate; the rebellious captive Yao Hong was bound by the neck and captured.
translations.idiomatic: He drove to Ba and Chan, hung banners at Dragon Gate; Yao Hong was captured bound.

sentences.zh: 百稔梗穢，滌於崇朝；

translations.literal: A hundred years of choking filth was washed in one morning;
translations.idiomatic: A hundred years' filth was washed in one morning;

sentences.zh: 祖宗遺憤，雪於一旦。

translations.literal: the ancestors' lingering indignation was avenged in one day.
translations.idiomatic: the ancestors' rage was avened in one day.

sentences.zh: 涉禹之迹，方行天下，至于海外，罔有不服。

translations.literal: He trod Yu's traces and was about to travel the world; reaching beyond the seas, none failed to submit.
translations.idiomatic: He trod Yu's traces toward the world; beyond the seas none failed to submit.

sentences.zh: 功固萬世，其寧惟永，豈金石雅頌所能讚揚，實可以告於神明，勒銘嵩、岱者已。

translations.literal: Achievement is solid for ten thousand generations—how could it be only eternal? Truly it can be told to the spirits and inscribed on Song and Dai.
translations.idiomatic: Merit is solid for ten thousand generations; it can be told to spirits and inscribed on Song and Dai.

sentences.zh: 朕又聞之，周道方遠，則鸑鷟鳴岐，二南播德，則麟騶呈瑞。

translations.literal: We have also heard that when the Zhou way was far-reaching, then the zhuoque sang on Qi; when the two souths spread virtue, then the lin and sou appeared auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhou's way was far the zhuoque sang; when virtue spread the lin appeared.

sentences.zh: 自公大號初發，爰暨告成，靈祥炳煥，不可勝紀，豈伊素雉遠至，嘉禾近歸而已哉！

translations.literal: From when Gaozu first raised the great call until the report of completion, numinous omens blazed and could not be counted—how could it be only plain pheasants coming from afar and good grain returning near?
translations.idiomatic: From his first call to completion omens blazed beyond count—not only pheasants and good grain.

sentences.zh: 朕每仰鑒玄應，俯察人謀，進惟道勳，退惟國典，豈得遂公沖挹，而久蘊盛策。

translations.literal: Whenever We look up to mirror the dark response and look down to observe human plans, advancing We consider the way's achievement and retreating We consider the state's canon—how can We follow Gaozu's modest restraint and long hoard the grand plan?
translations.idiomatic: We mirror heaven and men; how can we follow his modesty and hoard the grand plan?

sentences.zh: 便宜敬行大禮，允副幽顯之望。

translations.literal: It is fitting respectfully to carry out the great rites and fully answer the hope of hidden and manifest.
translations.idiomatic: It is time to carry out the great rites and answer hidden and manifest.

sentences.zh: 其進宋公爵為王，以徐州之海陵東安北琅邪北東莞北東海北譙北梁、豫州之汝南北潁川北南頓凡十郡，益宋國。

translations.literal: Let him advance the Duke of Song's rank to King, with Hailing, Dong'an, Northern Langye, Northern Dongguan, Northern Donghai, Northern Qiao, Northern Liang of Xu and Runan, Northern Yingchuan, Northern Nandun of Yu—ten commanderies in all—and enlarge the state of Song.
translations.idiomatic: Advance the Duke of Song to King with ten commanderies and enlarge Song.

sentences.zh: 其相國、揚州牧、領征西將軍、司豫北徐雍四州刺史如故。

translations.literal: Prime Minister, Governor of Yangzhou, holding General Who Campaigns West and Inspector of Si, Yu, Northern Xu, and Yong, as before.
translations.idiomatic: Prime Minister, Yangzhou governor, Campaign West and Si, Yu, Northern Xu, Yong—as before.

sentences.zh: 十一月，前將軍劉穆之卒，以左司馬徐羨之代掌留任。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Forward General Liu Muzhi died; Left Army Marshal Xu Xianzhi replaced him in charge of affairs left behind.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Liu Muzhi died; Xu Xianzhi replaced him in the capital.

sentences.zh: 大事昔所決於穆之者，皆悉以諮。

translations.literal: Great affairs formerly decided by Muzhi were all consulted.
translations.idiomatic: Great affairs once Muzhi's were all consulted.

sentences.zh: 公欲息駕長安，經略趙、魏，會穆之卒，乃歸。

translations.literal: Gaozu wished to rest his chariot in Chang'an and plan for Zhao and Wei; when Muzhi died he returned.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu wished to stay in Chang'an and plan Zhao and Wei; when Muzhi died he returned.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，發自長安，以桂陽公義真為安西將軍、雍州刺史，留腹心將佐以輔之。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi in the twelfth month he set out from Chang'an, making Duke of Guiyang Yizhen General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yongzhou, leaving trusted generals and aides to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the twelfth month he left Chang'an, made Yizhen of Guiyang Pacifier of the West and Yong's inspector, and left trusted aides.

sentences.zh: 閏月，公自洛入河，開汴渠以歸。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month Gaozu entered the river from Luo and opened the Bian canal to return.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month he entered the river from Luo and opened the Bian canal homeward.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月壬戌，公至彭城，解嚴息甲。

translations.literal: On the day renxu in the first month of the fourteenth year Gaozu reached Pengcheng, stood down the army, and rested armor.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the first month of the fourteenth year he reached Pengcheng and stood the army down.

sentences.zh: 以輔國將軍劉遵考為并州刺史，領河東太守，鎮蒲坂。

translations.literal: He made General Who Supports the State Liu Zunkao Inspector of Bingzhou, holding the office of Administrator of Hedong and garrisoning Puban.
translations.idiomatic: He made Liu Zunkao Bing's inspector, holding Hedong and garrisoning Puban.

sentences.zh: 公解司州，領徐、冀二州刺史，固讓進爵。

translations.literal: Gaozu relinquished Si province and held Xu and Ji provinces, firmly declining advancement in rank.
translations.idiomatic: He gave up Si and held Xu and Ji, firmly declining higher rank.

sentences.zh: 六月，受相國宋公九錫之命。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he received the command of Prime Minister Duke of Song's nine bestowals.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he received the nine honors as Prime Minister Duke of Song.

sentences.zh: 令曰：「孤以寡薄，負荷殊重，守位奉藩，危溢是懼。

translations.literal: He ordered: "I, few and slight, bear a special weight; holding position and serving as frontier lord, overflow of peril is my fear.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered: "I am slight yet bear a heavy charge; holding rank I fear overflow.

sentences.zh: 朝恩隆泰，委美推功，遂方軌齊、晉，擬議國典。

translations.literal: Court grace is lofty and abundant; merit is entrusted and pushed upon me; thus to square the track of Qi and Jin and compare with the state's canon.
translations.idiomatic: Court grace is lofty; merit is pushed on me; thus to match Qi and Jin and the state's canon.

sentences.zh: 雖亮誠守分，十稔于今，而成命弗迴，百辟胥暨內外庶僚，敦勉周至。

translations.literal: Though bright sincerity has guarded its portion for ten years until now, the completed mandate does not turn back; the hundred officials all join, inner and outer civil and military, urging earnestly and arriving in full.
translations.idiomatic: Though I have guarded my portion ten years, the mandate does not turn; officials urge earnestly.

sentences.zh: 籍運來之功，參休明之迹，乘菲薄之資，同盛德之事，監寐永言，未知攸託。

translations.literal: Relying on the merit of the turn's coming, sharing in the bright trace, riding slight substance, sharing in the affair of abundant virtue—watching and sleeping I speak forever, not knowing where to entrust.
translations.idiomatic: Relying on the turn's merit, riding slight substance in a great affair—I do not know where to entrust myself.

sentences.zh: 隆祚之始，思覃斯慶。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the lofty fortune I think to spread this celebration.
translations.idiomatic: At the fortune's beginning I spread this celebration.

sentences.zh: 其赦國內殊死以下，今月二十三日昧爽以前，悉皆原宥。

translations.literal: Let those within the state guilty of special death and below, before dawn on the twenty-third of this month, all be pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Pardon special death and below within the state before dawn on the twenty-third.

sentences.zh: 鰥寡孤獨不能自存者，人賜粟五斛。

translations.literal: Widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary who cannot support themselves shall each be given five hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Widows, orphans, and the solitary shall each receive five hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 府州刑罪，亦同蕩然。

translations.literal: Criminal cases of the headquarters and provinces shall likewise be cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Headquarters and provincial crimes are likewise cleared.

sentences.zh: 其餘詳依舊準。

translations.literal: The rest in detail follow the old standard."
translations.idiomatic: The rest follow the old standard."

sentences.zh: 」詔崇豫章公太夫人為宋公太妃，世子中軍將軍，副貳相國府。

translations.literal: An edict honored the Grand Lady of Duke of Yuzhang as Grand Consort of the Duke of Song, the Heir as Central Army General, and deputy second to the Prime Minister's headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made the Grand Lady of Yuzhang Grand Consort of Song, the heir Central Army General and deputy to the prime minister.

sentences.zh: 以太尉軍諮祭酒孔季恭為宋國尚書令，青州刺史檀祗為領軍將軍，相國左長史王弘為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: Grand Commandant Army Consulting Sacrificer Kong Jigong was made Director of the Masters of Writing of the state of Song; Inspector of Qingzhou Tan Zhi was made Defender Army General; Chief of Staff of the Prime Minister's Left Wang Hong was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Jigong became Song's Director of the Masters of Writing; Tan Zhi Defender Army General; Wang Hong Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 其餘百官悉依天朝之制。

translations.literal: The rest of the hundred offices all followed the heavenly court's system.
translations.idiomatic: The rest followed the imperial system.

sentences.zh: 又詔宋國所封十郡之外，悉得除用。

translations.literal: Another edict said that beyond the ten commanderies enfeoffed to the state of Song, all might be appointed and used.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict allowed appointments beyond Song's ten commanderies.

sentences.zh: 先是安西中兵參軍沈田子殺安西司馬王鎮惡，諸將軍復殺安西長史王脩。

translations.literal: Earlier Pacify-the-West Central Army Registrar Shen Tianzi killed Pacify-the-West Marshal Wang Zhen'e, and the generals again killed Pacify-the-West Chief of Staff Wang Xiu.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Shen Tianzi killed Wang Zhen'e; generals killed Wang Xiu.

sentences.zh: 關中亂。

translations.literal: Guanzhong was in disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Guanzhong fell into disorder.

sentences.zh: 十月，公遣右將軍朱齡石代安西將軍桂陽公義真為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Gaozu sent Right General Zhu Lingshi to replace Pacify-the-West General Duke of Guiyang Yizhen as Inspector of Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he sent Zhu Lingshi to replace Yizhen as Yong's inspector.

sentences.zh: 義真既還，為佛佛虜所追，大敗，僅以身免。

translations.literal: When Yizhen had returned he was pursued by the Fofo barbarians, greatly defeated, and barely escaped with his life.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhen was pursued by the Fofo barbarians, greatly beaten, and barely escaped.

sentences.zh: 諸將帥及齡石並沒。

translations.literal: The generals and commanders and Lingshi all perished.
translations.idiomatic: Generals and Lingshi all perished.

sentences.zh: 領軍檀祗卒，以中軍司馬檀道濟為中領軍。

translations.literal: Defender Army Tan Zhi died; Central Army Marshal Tan Daoji was made Central Defender.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Zhi died; Tan Daoji became Central Defender.

sentences.zh: 十二月，天子崩，大司馬琅邪王即帝位。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the Son of Heaven died; Grand Marshal Prince of Langye succeeded to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the emperor died; Prince of Langye succeeded.

sentences.zh: 十二月，天子命王冕十有二旒，建天子旌旗，出警入蹕，乘金根車，駕六馬，備五時副車，置旄頭雲罕，樂舞八佾，設鍾虡宮縣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the Son of Heaven ordered a royal cap with twelve tassels, erected the Son of Heaven's banners, went out with police and returned with imperial halts, rode the golden-root chariot with six horses, prepared the five seasonal secondary chariots, set the standard-bearers Maotou and Yunhan, music and dance of eight rows, and set bells and musical stands in the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the emperor ordered a twelve-tassel cap, imperial banners, police and halts, the golden chariot with six horses, five seasonal chariots, standard-bearers, eight rows of dance, and palace bells.

sentences.zh: 進王太妃為太后，王妃為王后，世子為太子，王子、王孫爵命之號，一如舊儀。

translations.literal: He advanced the King's Grand Consort to Empress Dowager, the King's consort to Queen, the Heir to Crown Prince; the titles enfeoffing princes and grandsons of the king followed the old statutes.
translations.idiomatic: He made the Grand Consort Empress Dowager, the consort Queen, the heir Crown Prince; princes' titles followed old statute.

sentences.zh: 二年四月，徵王入輔。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year he summoned the King to enter and assist.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year he summoned the King to the capital.

sentences.zh: 六月，至京師。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 晉帝禪位于王，詔曰：

translations.literal: The Jin emperor abdicated the throne to the King; the edict said:
translations.idiomatic: The Jin emperor abdicated to the King; the edict said:

sentences.zh: 夫天造草昧，樹之司牧，所以陶鈞三極，統天施化。

translations.literal: When heaven made the grass and wilds, it set up stewards over them; therefore the great way travels, selects the worthy and able, rise and fall have no fixed term, abdication and change are not one clan—threading through the hundred kings, honored from of old.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven made the wilds and set stewards; the great way selects the able; rise and fall have no fixed term; abdication is not one clan—honored from of old.

sentences.zh: 故大道之行，選賢與能，隆替無常期，禪代非一族，貫之百王，由來尚矣。

translations.literal: The way of Jin declined and for generations there were many causes; reaching Yuanxing, calamity and hardship accumulated; until the three luminaries traded place and crown and shoes changed footing; Emperor An was driven about and the ancestral sacrifices toppled and were extinguished—then the fortunes of Xuan and Yuan forever fell to the ground; looking over the realm, it was already cut down.
translations.idiomatic: Jin's way declined; calamity piled to Yuanxing; the throne shifted; Emperor An was driven out and sacrifice died—Xuan and Yuan's fortune fell; the realm was cut down.

sentences.zh: 晉道陵遲，仍世多故，爰暨元興，禍難既積，至三光貿位，冠履易所，安皇播越，宗祀墮泯，則我宣、元之祚，永墜于地，顧瞻區域，翦焉已傾。

translations.literal: Prime Minister of Song, the King was heaven-conferred sage virtue and divine martial outstanding in the age; he corrected the leaning turn and remade the realm within Xia—thus he continued the fallen and carried the drowned in the boat.
translations.idiomatic: The King of Song was heaven-sage and martially outstanding; he corrected the leaning age and remade the realm—continuing the fallen and carrying the drowned.

sentences.zh: 相國宋王，天縱聖德，靈武秀世，一匡頹運，再造區夏，固以興滅繼絕，舟航淪溺矣。

translations.literal: As for looking up to the celestial pearl and assisting the seven regulators, making light campaign against those not at court and opening and recovering frontier territory—
translations.idiomatic: He looked to heaven and the seven regulators, campaigned against rebels, and opened the frontier—

sentences.zh: 若夫仰在璿璣，旁穆七政，薄伐不庭，開復疆宇。

translations.literal: then he thrice captured false rulers, opened and washed the five capitals; in villages of tattooed faces and barbarian dress, and among chiefs of the dragon wilds and northern deserts, none failed to turn their heads to the morning sun and bathe in dark grace.
translations.idiomatic: he thrice captured false rulers, opened the five capitals; tattooed villages and desert chiefs turned to the sun and bathed in grace.

sentences.zh: 遂乃三俘偽主，開滌五都，雕顏卉服之鄉，龍荒朔漠之長，莫不迴首朝陽，沐浴玄澤。

translations.literal: Therefore the four numina offered auspicious response, rivers and mountains opened charts, good omens piled in mixture, and excellent responses blazed forth; dark images showed the term of revolution and Chinese and barbarians noted the wish to push him with music.
translations.idiomatic: The four spirits offered omens; rivers opened charts; revolution's term and the people's wish to push him with music were clear.

sentences.zh: 故四靈効瑞，川岳啟圖，嘉祥雜遝，休應炳著，玄象表革命之期，華裔注樂推之願。

translations.literal: The talisman of changing virtue appeared in hidden and manifest; gazing at the crow they all gathered—the wise; how could it be only that Yankang had a return and Xianxi announced thanks!
translations.idiomatic: The talisman of change appeared; the wise gathered—not only Yankang's return and Xianxi's thanks!

sentences.zh: 代德之符，著乎幽顯，瞻烏爰止，允集明哲，夫豈延康有歸，咸熙告謝而已哉！

translations.literal: Formerly when the fire virtue was already slight, the Wei ancestor established achievement; the yellow turn did not compete and the three queens labored earnestly.
translations.idiomatic: When fire virtue waned Wei established merit; the three queens labored.

sentences.zh: 昔火德既微，魏祖底績，黃運不競，三后肆勤。

translations.literal: Thus heaven's allotted span truly has its place.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's span truly has its place.

sentences.zh: 故天之曆數，實有攸在。

translations.literal: We, though mediocre and dim, are dull in the great way; long mirroring rise and fall, it has been many days.
translations.idiomatic: We are dim in the great way; long we have mirrored rise and fall.

sentences.zh: 朕雖庸闇，昧於大道，永鑒廢興，為日已久。

translations.literal: Thinking of the high righteousness of the four eras and examining heaven and men's utmost hope, We shall yield the throne to a separate palace and abdicate to Song, all following the stories of Tang-Yao, Yu-Shun, Han, and Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Thinking of four eras' righteousness and heaven and men's hope, we yield the throne and abdicate to Song as Tang, Yu, Han, and Wei did.

sentences.zh: 念四代之高義，稽天人之至望，予其遜位別宮，歸禪于宋，一依唐虞、漢魏故事。

translations.literal: When the draft edict was complete it was sent to be written by the Son of Heaven; the Son of Heaven at once took up the brush and said to those at his side: "In Huan Xuan's time the mandate of heaven had already changed; We were extended again by Duke Liu for nearly twenty years.
translations.idiomatic: When the draft was done the emperor took the brush and said: "In Huan Xuan's time the mandate had changed; Liu extended us nearly twenty years.

sentences.zh: 詔草既成，送呈天子使書之，天子即便操筆，謂左右曰：「桓玄之時，天命已改，重為劉公所延，將二十載。

translations.literal: Today's affair is what We have wished from the heart."

translations.idiomatic: King of Song: In remote antiquity power arose—how far! Detail cannot be heard.

sentences.zh: 咨爾宋王：夫玄古權輿，悠哉邈矣，其詳靡得而聞。

translations.literal: From the written covenant down to the Three and Five, none failed to use the highest sage to rule the four seas, stop arms and settle the great enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: From written covenant to the Three and Five, sages ruled the seas, stopped arms, and settled the enterprise.

sentences.zh: 爰自書契，降逮三、五，莫不以上聖君四海，止戈定大業。

translations.literal: Thus the emperor-king is the common vessel for ruling things;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor is the vessel for ruling things;

sentences.zh: 然則帝王者，宰物之通器；

translations.literal: the way of the ruler is the utmost fairness under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: the ruler's way is utmost fairness under heaven.

sentences.zh: 君道者，天下之至公。

translations.literal: Formerly in the high antiquity they deeply mirrored this way; thus when heaven's fortune had ended, Tang and Yu could not pass their heirs;
translations.idiomatic: In high antiquity they mirrored this way; when fortune ended Tang and Yu could not pass heirs;

sentences.zh: 昔在上葉，深鑒茲道，是以天祿既終，唐、虞弗得傳其嗣；

translations.literal: when the mandate came, Shun and Yu could not keep their modesty complete.
translations.idiomatic: when the mandate came Shun and Yu could not keep full modesty.

sentences.zh: 符命來格，舜、禹不獲全其謙。

translations.literal: Therefore they wove the three powers, clarified and ordered ritual transformation, made model to shake antiquity and handed down wind for ten thousand generations—none is greater than this.
translations.idiomatic: They wove the three powers, ordered ritual, made model for antiquity—none greater.

sentences.zh: 所以經緯三才，澄序彝化，作範振古，垂風萬葉，莫尚於茲。

translations.literal: From then on for generations it was still more strict; Han succeeded the virtue of Emperor Yao and Wei squared the track of Chonghua.
translations.idiomatic: Then generations grew stricter; Han succeeded Yao and Wei matched Chonghua.

sentences.zh: 自是厥後，歷代彌劭，漢既嗣德於放勛，魏亦方軌於重華。

translations.literal: Truly they harmonized plans among men and spirits and took the hundred surnames as heart.
translations.idiomatic: They harmonized men and spirits and took the people as heart.

sentences.zh: 諒以協謀乎人鬼，而以百姓為心者也。

translations.literal: Formerly Our ancestors were reverent and bright; The celestial seat was at its pole, yet bright and dim alternated in sequence and fullness and deficit had their terms.
translations.idiomatic: Our ancestors were bright; the seat was at its pole, yet bright and dim alternated.

sentences.zh: 昔我祖宗欽明，辰居其極，而明晦代序，盈虧有期。

translations.literal: The omen of cutting Shang brought calamity—not for one generation alone; once it could not be overcome—how much more in the present day; what heaven has discarded has long had its coming.
translations.idiomatic: Cutting Shang's omen brought calamity for generations; heaven's discard has long come.

sentences.zh: 翦商兆禍，非唯一世，曾是弗剋，矧伊在今，天之所廢，有自來矣。

translations.literal: Only the King embodies the posture of the highest sage, embraces the virtue of the two principles, bright as sun and moon, his way matches the four seasons.
translations.idiomatic: The King embodies highest sage posture, embraces two principles' virtue, bright as sun and moon.

sentences.zh: 惟王體上聖之姿，苞二儀之德，明齊日月，道合四時。

translations.literal: Then the altars toppled and the King rescued and preserved them; the central plains lay waste with brambles and he crossed and restored them.
translations.idiomatic: The altars toppled and he saved them; the center lay waste and he restored it.

sentences.zh: 乃者社稷傾覆，王拯而存之，中原蕪梗，又濟而復之。

translations.literal: From those who relied on solidity and would not guest, to those who violated discipline and defied command, running riot to flood heaven and usurping ten thousand li—
translations.idiomatic: From stubborn lords to rebels who flooded heaven and seized ten thousand li—

sentences.zh: 自負固不賓，干紀放命，肆逆滔天，竊據萬里。

translations.literal: none failed to be moistened by wind and rain, shaken by thunder.
translations.idiomatic: none failed to be moistened by wind and rain, shaken by thunder.

sentences.zh: 靡不潤之以風雨，震之以雷霆。

translations.literal: The way of the nine campaigns was already spread; the transformation of the eight methods was naturally ordered.
translations.idiomatic: The nine campaigns spread; the eight methods ordered themselves.

sentences.zh: 九伐之道既敷，八法之化自理。

translations.literal: How could it be only broadly bestowing on the people and aiding these black-headed people;
translations.idiomatic: Not only broadly bestowing on the people;

sentences.zh: 豈伊博施於民，濟斯黔庶；

translations.literal: firmly righteousness harmonized the four seas and the way awed the eight wilds.
translations.idiomatic: righteousness harmonized the four seas and awed the eight wilds.

sentences.zh: 固以義洽四海，道威八荒者矣。

translations.literal: As for heaven hanging images and the four numina offering auspicious response, the texts of charts and prophecies were already clear and the hope of men and spirits had already changed.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven hung images; spirits offered omens; charts were clear; men and spirits had changed.

sentences.zh: 至於上天垂象，四靈效徵，圖讖之文既明，人神之望已改。

translations.literal: The hundred craftsmen sang in court and the multitude praised in the wild; the hundred millions danced and leaned and gazed, all looking only for the new.
translations.idiomatic: Craftsmen sang in court; people praised in the wild; millions danced and looked for the new.

sentences.zh: 百工歌於朝，庶民頌于野，億兆抃踊，傾佇惟新。

translations.literal: Unless the hundred surnames gladly pushed and heaven's mandate thus gathered, how could it be in Us alone that the exclusive right was obtained?
translations.idiomatic: Unless the people pushed and heaven gathered, how could we alone obtain it?

sentences.zh: 自非百姓樂推，天命攸集，豈伊在予，所得獨專。

translations.literal: Therefore We respectfully received the imperial spirit and followed the multitude's counsel, respectfully abdicated the sacred vessel, and conferred the emperor's position on your person.
translations.idiomatic: We received the spirit, followed counsel, abdicated the throne, and conferred the emperor's seat on you.

sentences.zh: 是用仰祗皇靈，俯順羣議，敬禪神器，授帝位于爾躬。

translations.literal: The great fortune announced its end; heaven's allotment forever ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Fortune announced its end; heaven's allotment ceased.

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

translations.idiomatic: King, hold the center, follow the canon, answer the realm's wish, restore the enterprise, receive blessing, answer the three spirits.

sentences.zh: 王其允執其中，敬遵典訓，副率土之嘉願，恢洪業於無窮，時膺休祐，以答三靈之眷望。

translations.idiomatic: Again the sealed letter said:

sentences.zh: 又璽書曰：

translations.literal: We have heard that heaven bore the teeming people and set up a ruler over them; emperor and king entrusted generations and truly gave the four seas; rise and fall depend on merit and virtue; advancement and decline rest in the man.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven bore the people and set a ruler; rise and fall rest on merit and the man.

sentences.zh: 蓋聞天生蒸民，樹之以君，帝皇寄世，實公四海，崇替係於勳德，升降存乎其人。

translations.literal: Therefore states must perish and the divined years show their number; change has no constancy and the sage grasps its talisman.
translations.idiomatic: States perish; years show their number; change has no constancy; the sage grasps the talisman.

sentences.zh: 故有國必亡，卜年著其數，代謝無常，聖哲握其符。

translations.literal: Formerly in the high age the three sages linked their tracks; they consulted the four mountains to enlarge yielding and abdication.
translations.idiomatic: In the high age the three sages linked tracks and consulted the four mountains to enlarge abdication.

sentences.zh: 昔在上世，三聖係軌，疇咨四嶽，以弘揖讓。

translations.literal: Only when the former kings had achievement did they forever hand down model without end.
translations.idiomatic: When former kings achieved, they handed down model without end.

sentences.zh: 惟先王之有作，永垂範於無窮。

translations.literal: When the Liu house carried out abdication it truly took Yao as law; when Wei announced its end it likewise took this canon.
translations.idiomatic: Liu's abdication took Yao as law; Wei's end took the same canon.

sentences.zh: 及劉氏致禪，實堯是法，有魏告終，亦憲茲典。

translations.literal: Our High Ancestor therefore soothed the returning turn and followed human affairs, riding advantage to see and fixing heaven's protection.
translations.idiomatic: Our High Ancestor soothed the turn, followed human affairs, and fixed heaven's protection.

sentences.zh: 我世祖所以撫歸運而順人事，乘利見而定天保者也。

translations.literal: Yet the way is not forever peaceful; barbarians disturbed Hua; we lost our Luo food and the state was cramped on the river's south; again meeting ill fortune, sinking and drowning followed one another.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the way was not forever peaceful; barbarians disturbed Hua; we lost Luo and cramped south; fortune sank again and again.

sentences.zh: 而道不常泰，戎夷亂華，喪我洛食，蹙國江表，仍遘否運，淪沒相因。

translations.literal: Reaching Yuanxing, the ancestral sacrifices then toppled.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Yuanxing sacrifice toppled.

sentences.zh: 逮于元興，遂傾宗祀。

translations.literal: Fortunately relying on divine martial illuminating heaven, the great principle broadly arose, he corrected and restored Our altars and remade Our state.
translations.idiomatic: Fortunately divine martial illuminated heaven; he restored our altars and remade our state.

sentences.zh: 幸賴神武光天，大節宏發，匡復我社稷，重造我國家。

translations.literal: Only the King's sage virtue is reverent and bright; then heaven's light is great; he answered the age and was born; he brightly protected the royal house.
translations.idiomatic: The King's sage virtue is bright; he answered the age and protected the house.

sentences.zh: 惟王聖德欽明，則天光大，應期誕載，明保王室。

translations.literal: Inward he eased the state's hardship, outward he spread the grand plan; he executed the great villain at Hanyang and drove the usurping bandit from Yizhu; he cleared the atmosphere west of Min and pacified the south beyond Yue; again he quieted Jiang and Xiang and opened and settled Fan and Mian.
translations.idiomatic: Inward he eased hardship, outward he spread the plan; he executed villains at Hanyang, cleared west and south, quieted Jiang and Xiang, opened Fan and Mian.

sentences.zh: 內紓國難，外播宏略，誅太憝於漢陽，逋僭盜於沂渚，澄氛西岷，肅清南越，再靜江、湘，拓定樊、沔。

translations.literal: As for forever cherishing the realm and thinking to unify sound and teaching—when the royal army took the first road, then Yi and Luo ran clear; when awl authority reached Xiao and Tong, then Mount Hua lifted mist; false chiefs held jade and Xianyang was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Forever cherishing the realm, when the royal army moved Yi and Luo ran clear; at Xiao and Tong Hua lifted mist; false chiefs submitted at Xianyang.

sentences.zh: 若乃永懷區宇，思一聲教，王師首路，則伊、洛澄流，稜威崤、潼，則華嶽褰靄，偽酋銜璧，咸陽即序。

translations.literal: Though what ritual vessels record and odes and documents praise—in majestic achievement none is second.
translations.idiomatic: Though vessels and odes praise achievement, none is second.

sentences.zh: 雖彝器所銘，詩書所詠，庸勳之盛，莫之與二也。

translations.literal: Then he halted arms and cultivated letters, broadly spread virtuous government; eight registries to govern ten thousand people, nine offices to punish the state; he thought to encompass the three kings and apply the four affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Then he halted arms, spread virtue; eight registries governed the people; he encompassed the three kings.

sentences.zh: 遂偃武修文，誕敷德政，八統以馭萬民，九職以刑邦國，思兼三王，以施四事。

translations.literal: Therefore trust showed in hidden and manifest and righteousness moved distant regions.
translations.idiomatic: Trust showed in hidden and manifest; righteousness moved distant regions.

sentences.zh: 故能信著幽顯，義感殊方。

translations.literal: From generations that were guests to where chariots and boats reached, none failed to sing of benevolent virtue and dance in coming to court.
translations.idiomatic: From guest generations to chariot and boat reach, all sang benevolence and danced to court.

sentences.zh: 自歷世所賓，舟車所暨，靡不謳歌仁德，抃舞來庭。

translations.literal: Whenever We respectfully consider the way's achievement and forever observe the talisman of the turn, heaven's allotted span is truly in your person.
translations.idiomatic: We consider the way's achievement; heaven's span is in your person.

sentences.zh: 朕每敬惟道勳，永察符運，天之曆數，實在爾躬。

translations.literal: Therefore the five cords rose in degree and repeatedly showed traces of removing the old;
translations.idiomatic: The five cords rose and showed removing the old;

sentences.zh: 是以五緯升度，屢示除舊之迹；

translations.literal: the three luminaries harmonized in number and surely displayed omens of spreading the new.
translations.idiomatic: the three luminaries harmonized and displayed spreading the new.

sentences.zh: 三光協數，必昭布新之祥。

translations.literal: Charts, prophecies, and auspicious omens blazed forth therein.
translations.idiomatic: Charts and omens blazed forth.

sentences.zh: 圖讖禎瑞，皎然斯在。

translations.literal: Moreover the dragon countenance was heroic and special; heaven bestowed extraordinary posture; the mark of a ruler blazed like sun and moon.
translations.idiomatic: His dragon countenance was heroic; heaven bestowed special form; his mark blazed like sun and moon.

sentences.zh: 加以龍顏英特，天授殊姿，君人之表，煥如日月。

translations.idiomatic: Tradition says: "Only heaven is great; only Yao matched it."

sentences.zh: 傳稱「惟天為大，惟堯則之」。

translations.literal: The Ode says: "There is a mandate from heaven; heaven commanded this King Wen."
translations.idiomatic: The Ode says: "There is a mandate from heaven; heaven commanded King Wen."

translations.idiomatic: When earth virtue announced calamity, fortune passed to our Jin;

translations.idiomatic: now fortune changes and ends here—with metal virtue it passes to Song.

translations.literal: Looking up to the rest righteousness of the four eras and mirroring the fixed term of bright and dim, We inquired of the lords and extended to the multitude of officials; all said excellent—none opposed Our will.
translations.idiomatic: Looking to four eras' rest righteousness and bright and dim's term, we inquired of lords and officials; all said excellent—none opposed our will.
