translations.literal: With the Bearer of the Staff one may kill those below two thousand dan; with a borrowed yellow axe one may exclusively execute commanders bearing staffs."
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of the Staff may kill below two thousand dan; borrowed yellow axe may execute staff-bearing commanders."

sentences.zh: 卜世未改 「卜世」各本並作「十世」。

translations.literal: The allotted age not yet changed—"allotted age" in all editions reads "ten generations."
translations.idiomatic: The allotted age not yet changed—"allotted age" in all editions reads "ten generations."

sentences.zh: 按自西晉武帝至東晉安帝，已十四世，言十世，無據。

translations.literal: From Western Jin's Emperor Wu to Eastern Jin's Emperor An is already fourteen generations; to say ten generations has no basis.
translations.idiomatic: From Western Jin's Wu to Eastern Jin's An is fourteen generations; "ten generations" has no basis.

sentences.zh: 「十世」當是「卜世」之誤，今改正。

translations.literal: "Ten generations" should be the error for "allotted age"; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: "Ten generations" should be the error for "allotted age"; now corrected.

sentences.zh: 去秋遣康之送還司馬君者 「君」各本並作「軍」，據晉書譙剛王遜傳玄孫休之附傳、元龜七二五改。

translations.literal: Last autumn sent Kang to return the Lord of Sima—"lord" in all editions reads "army"; corrected according to the Jin History biography of the Prince of Qiao Gang, Wang Xun's great-grandson Xiuzhi appended biography, and Yuance 725.
translations.idiomatic: Last autumn sent Kang to return the Lord of Sima—"lord" in all editions reads "army"; corrected per Jin History, Xiuzhi's appended biography, and Yuance 725.

sentences.zh: 此公之大節 各本並脫「大」字，據南史、建康實錄補。

translations.literal: This was Gaozu's great principle—all editions omit the character "great"; supplemented according to the Southern History and the Veritable Record of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: This was Gaozu's great principle—all editions omit "great"; supplemented per Southern History and Veritable Record of Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 一朝掃滌 「滌」各本並作「濟」，據南史、建康實錄改。

translations.literal: Swept away in one morning—"swept" in all editions reads "aided"; corrected according to the Southern History and the Veritable Record of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Swept away in one morning—"swept" in all editions reads "aided"; corrected per Southern History and Veritable Record of Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 今命使持節兼太尉尚書左僕射晉寧縣五等男湛授相國印綬 各本脫「今」字、「兼」字，並據南史、建康實錄補。

translations.literal: Now command Bearer of the Staff Concurrent Grand Commandant Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Baron of Jinning fifth rank Zhan to confer Prime Minister's seal and cord—all editions omit "now" and "concurrent"; supplemented according to the Southern History and the Veritable Record of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Now command Bearer Zhan to confer the Prime Minister's seal—all editions omit "now" and "concurrent"; supplemented per Southern History and Veritable Record of Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 金虎符第一至第五左 「第五」各本作「第十」，據南史改。

translations.literal: Golden tiger tally first through fifth left—"fifth" in all editions reads "tenth"; corrected according to the Southern History.
translations.idiomatic: Golden tiger tally first through fifth left—"fifth" in all editions reads "tenth"; corrected per Southern History.

sentences.zh: 其以相國總百揆 各本並脫「以」字，據南史、建康實錄補。

translations.literal: Let him as Prime Minister oversee the hundred officials—all editions omit "as"; supplemented according to the Southern History and the Veritable Record of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Let him as Prime Minister oversee the hundred officials—all editions omit "as"; supplemented per Southern History and Veritable Record of Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 上送所假節侍中貂蟬中外都督太傅太尉印綬 各本並脫「貂蟬」二字，據南史、建康實錄補。

translations.literal: Send up the borrowed staff, Palace Attendant, cicada-fur, seals of Concurrent Supervisor Within and Without, Grand Tutor, and Grand Commandant—all editions omit the two characters "cicada-fur"; supplemented according to the Southern History and the Veritable Record of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Send up borrowed staff, attendant's cicada-fur, seals—all editions omit "cicada-fur"; supplemented per Southern History and Veritable Record of Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 孫虨宋書考論云：「按宋、齊志皆不見侍中印綬，蓋但給朝服武冠貂蟬而巳。

translations.literal: Sun Biao's Critical Discussion on the Book of Song says: "According to the Song and Qi offices, Palace Attendant's seal and cord are not seen; probably only court robes, martial cap, and cicada-fur were given.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Biao says: "Song and Qi offices show no Palace Attendant seal; probably only robes, martial cap, and cicada-fur were given.

sentences.zh: 南史侍中下有貂蟬二字，是。」

translations.literal: The Southern History has the two characters 'cicada-fur' below Palace Attendant—so it is."
translations.idiomatic: Southern History has 'cicada-fur' below Palace Attendant—so it is."

sentences.zh: 置宋國侍中黃門侍郎尚書左丞郎隨大使奉迎 「郎」三朝本、北監本、毛本、局本同。

translations.literal: Set in the state of Song Palace Attendant, Gentleman of the Yellow Gate, Left Assistant of the Masters of Writing, and Gentlemen to follow the great envoy in welcome—"Gentlemen" in the Three Dynasties edition, Northern Directorate edition, Mao edition, and Bureau edition are the same.
translations.idiomatic: Set Song's attendants and gentlemen to follow the envoy—"Gentlemen" in Three Dynasties, Northern Directorate, Mao, and Bureau editions agree.

sentences.zh: 殿本、南史作「相」。

translations.literal: Palace Edition and Southern History read "chancellor."
translations.idiomatic: Palace Edition and Southern History read "chancellor."

sentences.zh: 李慈銘越縵堂日記補云：「當作即隨大使奉迎。」

translations.literal: Li Ciming's Supplementary Diary of the Yue Mantang says: "It should read 'then follow the great envoy in welcome.'"
translations.idiomatic: Li Ciming says: "It should read 'then follow the great envoy in welcome.'"

sentences.zh: 風雲玄感 「玄」各本並作「言」，據局本、文選、建康實錄、元龜二一０改。

translations.literal: Wind and cloud mysteriously responded—"mysterious" in all editions reads "words"; corrected according to the Bureau edition, Wen Xuan, the Veritable Record of Jiankang, and Yuance 210.
translations.idiomatic: Wind and cloud mysteriously responded—"mysterious" in all editions reads "words"; corrected per Bureau edition, Wen Xuan, Veritable Record of Jiankang, and Yuance 210.

sentences.zh: 以徐州之海陵北東海北譙北梁豫州之新蔡兗州之北陳留司州之陳郡汝南潁川滎陽十郡增宋國 「北東海」上之「北」字，各本並脫去。

translations.literal: With Hailing, Northern Donghai, Northern Qiao, Northern Liang of Xu and Xincai of Yu, Northern Chenliu of Yan, Chen of Si, Runan, Yingchuan, Xingyang of Yu—ten commanderies to enlarge the state of Song—the "Northern" before "Donghai" in all editions was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: Ten commanderies to enlarge Song—the "Northern" before "Donghai" was dropped in all editions.

sentences.zh: 據南史、建康實錄補。

translations.literal: Supplemented according to the Southern History and the Veritable Record of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Supplemented per Southern History and Veritable Record of Jiankang.
